cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), consisting of 52 patients with PROM and 89 patients without PROM.
finding: Higher HbA1c and fasting blood glucose levels, poor blood glucose control, and gestational weight gain were identified as risk factors for Premature Rupture of Membranes (PROM) in GDM patients, with HbA1c, insulin, and HOMA-IR being predictive of PROM risk.
